name: Fatima Al-Rashid
buyer_profile: Pro tier on her own account, bills cost to client
goals: Build reusable e-commerce client deliverables fast
Create a white-label client portal reskinnable per client
communication_style: Pragmatic, cost-conscious, wants reusable solutions, explains in business terms not tech terms
pain_points: Every client wants custom but budget is $5-10K
Spends 40% of time on manual reporting
No team to maintain what gets built
sample_prompts: Build a white-label e-commerce dashboard with sales, inventory, and customer metrics that I can reskin per client
Create an automated client reporting system that generates PDF reports from Shopify data weekly and emails the client
Build a multi-client portal where each of my clients logs in and sees only their own project status and invoices
